title: APC license file
description: Signed license (framework standard apc-license/1.0). The plugin ONLY verifies this file (common/apc/ApcLicense.h); both issuing methods (signed-file, online-activation) produce it. signature_ed25519 is base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON (apc-canon/1: keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes, no whitespace, integers only, see common/apc/ApcCanonicalJson.h) of this document WITHOUT the "signature_ed25519" member. The signing key is the dedicated LICENSE key - never the update key. All numbers MUST be integers. This file proves the developer issued it; it does not stop copying (see .agents/guides/licensing-methods.md).

product.description: Must equal the product identifier compiled into the plugin (LicenseConfig::product); a license for another product is UNVERIFIED.

customer_name.description: Shown in the plugin as "Licensed to ...".

issued_at.description: UTC, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date.

expires_at.description: null = never expires. Otherwise UTC, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. The member must be present (a missing expires_at is rejected by the plugin). now >= expires_at degrades the plugin to DEMO. subscription and trial licenses need a date.

allowed_seats.description: Informational inside the file: the plugin shows it, it cannot enforce it. Method B enforces seats on the issuer.

machine_components.description: Optional. Salted component hashes: hex of the first 8 bytes of SHA-256("apc-machine/1" 0x00 product 0x00 label 0x00 raw-value), computed by the plugin (machineComponentHash in ApcLicense.h). Absent = unbound license (e.g. nfr). Never contains raw hardware identifiers.

machine_min_match.description: Optional k of the k-of-n machine match (must not exceed the number of machine_components; the plugin clamps to [1, n]). Absent = the plugin's configured default (2).

signature_ed25519.description: base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of exactly 64 raw signature bytes.
